character.description: the same recurring anime protagonist in the art deco metropolis world, with consistent face, hairstyle, outfit silhouette, age impression, and body proportions throughout the entire music video
consistency_rules: keep the same face and hairstyle across scenes
keep outfit design and color identity consistent unless the story explicitly changes them
keep age impression, body proportions, and character identity stable
do not introduce additional protagonists unless the lyrics or scene require them

visual_language.action_style: expressive, readable full-body gestures; natural movement; clear pose silhouettes; avoid static repeated poses
visual_language.environment_style: rich anime background design rooted in stepped skyscraper skyline, marble lobby with gold geometry, rain-lit avenue with streamlined cars; preserve the theme's distinctive world and recognizable environmental details
visual_language.lighting_style: cinematic lighting harmonized with black and gold, emerald, champagne, midnight blue; coherent light direction, atmospheric depth, and controlled highlights
visual_language.composition_style: varied cinematic framing informed by low-angle shot up a stepped tower, symmetrical lobby dolly-in, tracking along a rain-slick avenue; clear subject separation and intentional negative space

available_styles: low-angle shot up a stepped tower
camera_guidance.principle: vary shot scale and viewpoint to support the scene; avoid repeating identical framing in consecutive scenes
